policy: Every asset needs an explicit licence row in imports/v2/dispositions.json before entering a signed pack; assets never inherit a repository licence.

assets.redistribution: MIT-derived per upstream WHISPER_MIT notice; pack-manifest row must close it before entering the signed speech pack

policy_notes: Model bytes were NOT copied by CR-V2-B1-012/013; every referenced_external_assets row with sha256=null must obtain the exact byte hash from the signed pack builder before closure.
blocked_unresolved rows are release-blocking per docs/legal/V2-IMPORT-POLICY.md section 3.
No licence is inferred from filenames or repository ownership; rows record only evidence actually present in the vendored tree or the frozen corpus.
